goal_title: Remove chamber maps; distribute gaming layer into every teaching map
why: Chambers were bolted-on integration rooms. The biome + grammar + catalyst system already provides integration environmentally — every teaching map in a sequence inherits its ecosystem. Removing chambers simplifies the architecture and makes every map a complete experience rather than a setup for a finale.
success_criteria: 17 Chamber_* maps removed from sequence JSONs (not deleted yet — archived)
Every non-chamber map has biome wiring (BiomeRingComponent reading current sequence)
Every sequence exposes its catalyst mode in at least one non-chamber map
Creatures/hazards distributed to thematically-appropriate teaching maps
VR walkthrough of primitives sequence confirms complete experience without chamber

tasks.title: Audit chamber uniqueness — what exists only in chambers?
tasks.spec: Read each Chamber_*/map_data.json (17 maps). For each artifact placed there, check: does it appear in any other map? Produce doc/tasks/_audits/chamber_unique.md listing: (1) artifacts only-in-chambers that need relocation, (2) artifacts also elsewhere (chamber was just repeating), (3) narrative content (subtitles, utility_definitions) that needs to migrate.

tasks.title: Design gaming-layer distribution rule
tasks.spec: Write doc/curriculum_audit/_gaming_layer.md specifying: which teaching map gets the catalyst pedestal per sequence, which gets creatures (first, mid, or last map?), how friend/foe transitions happen, hazard grammar per sequence. Should be opinionated enough that 17 removals can follow mechanically.

tasks.title: Prototype: convert primitives sequence (remove Chamber_Primitives)
tasks.spec: Follow the distribution rule from task 002 for the primitives sequence only. (a) Read Chamber_Primitives/map_data.json contents. (b) Distribute becoming_catalyst, catalyst_target, science_screen content to appropriate teaching maps in the sequence. (c) Remove Chamber_Primitives from commons/maps/sequences/primitives.json maps[]. (d) Archive Chamber_Primitives folder to commons/maps/_archived_chambers/. (e) Verify all primitives-sequence maps pass pathfinder. (f) Document the moves in doc/tasks/_audits/primitives_distribution.md.
tasks.verification: python tools/map_pathfinder.py check --all | grep === && ! grep -q Chamber_Primitives commons/maps/sequences/primitives.json

tasks.title: VR verify primitives without chamber
tasks.spec: Launch Ada in VR (or desktop), walk the primitives sequence. Write doc/tasks/_audits/primitives_vr_review.md: does the sequence feel complete? Does the catalyst appear at a good moment? Are creatures in right places? Do hazards create pressure without frustration?

tasks.title: Apply to remaining 16 sequences
tasks.spec: Once primitives is validated, repeat the pattern (tasks 001–003) for each other sequence. This should be split into 16 subtasks but can be a single focused effort if the pattern holds.
